findings.current: He began sprinting at a speed Im Kkeokjeong, an E-rank Hunter, could neither match nor properly see.
findings.defect: The source says Kkeokjeong could neither touch/reach Taekyung nor properly see him at that speed. “Match” changes the physical inability to reach him into an inability to equal his speed.
findings.rationale: 닿을 수도 없다는 것은 곧 뻗으려던 손이 태경에게 닿지 못한다는 물리적 세부를 이어 간다.
findings.replacement: He began sprinting at a speed that left Im Kkeokjeong, an E-rank Hunter, unable even to touch him or see him clearly.

findings.defect: The source contains one apology with an initial stutter, not two complete apologies.
findings.rationale: “죄, 죄송합니다!” marks frightened hesitation within a single utterance; converting it into repetition changes the delivery.

summary: The chapter is highly faithful overall, with two minor defects involving a physical action and a stuttered apology.
